sqlMap.select:
SELECT *
FROM ICOMTRXL WHERE DOC_NAME = 'APPROVAL' AND TARGET = 'KRDAED0079' AND KEY_9 = 'N'

SELECT a.buyer as BUYER, nvl(a.add_user_name,' ') AS REQ_USER_NAME, a.buyer_item_no||'-'|| replace(replace(a.description,'''',''),'"','') AS DESCRIPTION, a.target_qty AS ITEM_QTY, 'EA' AS UNIT_MEASURE, a.rd_date AS RD_DATE, a.target_price AS UNIT_PRICE, a.ref_pr_no AS REF_PR_NO, f_split(a.dely_to_location,'-',1) as PLANT, f_split(a.dely_to_location,'-',2) as DELY_TO_LOCATION, a.budget_dept AS BUDGET_DEPT, a.account_type AS ACCOUNT_TYPE, a.pr_no||'-'||a.pr_seq AS PR_NO, a.pr_no AS PRDT_PR_NO, a.pr_seq AS PR_SEQ, a.ref_no AS REF_NO, b.change_user_name AS REV_USER_NAME, a.purchaser_dept AS PURCHASER_DEPT, (SELECT CODE FROM ICOMCOD2 WHERE COMPANY_CODE = a.buyer AND TYPE = 'M014' AND TEXT1 = a.REF_PR_NO AND ROWNUM =1) AS ITEM_GROUP, (SELECT NVL(TEXT1, 'D10') FROM ICOMCOD2 WHERE COMPANY_CODE = a.BUYER AND TYPE = 'C004' AND CODE = a.PURCHASER_DEPT) AS PUR_GROUP
FROM icomprdt a,icomprhd b WHERE a.buyer = #TARGET# AND a.ref_no = #KEY_1# AND a.status != 'D' AND a.buyer = b.buyer AND a.pr_no = b.pr_no AND b.status != 'D' AND a.recv_flag = 'PS' AND a.save_flag = 'PX' ORDER BY a.buyer, a.pr_no, a.pr_seq
sqlMap.update: UPDATE ICOMTRXL SET KEY_9 = 'T' , KEY_10 = TO_CHAR(SYSDATE,'YYYYMMDDHH24MISS') WHERE DOC_NAME = #DOC_NAME# AND TARGET = #TARGET# AND KEY_1 = #KEY_1# AND KEY_2 = #KEY_2# AND KEY_3 = #KEY_3# AND KEY_4 = #KEY_4# AND KEY_5 = #KEY_5# AND KEY_6 = #KEY_6# AND KEY_7 = #KEY_7# AND KEY_8 = #KEY_8# AND KEY_9 = #KEY_9# AND KEY_10 = #KEY_10#

UPDATE ICOMPRDT SET RECV_FLAG = 'PR' , CHANGE_DATE = TO_CHAR(SYSDATE,'YYYYMMDD') , CHANGE_TIME = TO_CHAR(SYSDATE,'HH24MISS') WHERE BUYER = #BUYER# AND PR_NO = #PR_NO# AND PR_SEQ = #PR_SEQ# AND RECV_FLAG = 'PS' AND SAVE_FLAG = 'PX'

UPDATE ICOMPRDT SET RECV_FLAG = 'PD' , CHANGE_DATE = TO_CHAR(SYSDATE,'YYYYMMDD') , CHANGE_TIME = TO_CHAR(SYSDATE,'HH24MISS') WHERE BUYER = #BUYER# AND PR_NO = #PR_NO# AND PR_SEQ = #PR_SEQ# AND RECV_FLAG = 'PS' AND SAVE_FLAG = 'PX'
